newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - TAMSA cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TAMSA cut to buy.

text.p: -- Bankers Trust said it had downgraded Tubos de Acero de Mexico SA, or TAMSA, to buy from strong buy.

-- In a report released on Thursday, analyst Kathleen Heaney wrote, "We estimate that TAMSA can maintain EBITDA growth in the 15-20 percent range for the next few years, which is in excess of most other Mexican companies and Latin American steel companies, but is in line with other international oil services companies.
-- TAMSA was off 3/8 to 17-1/8 in New York trade.
